AboutHero.title: ABOUT ME
AboutHero.name: I'm Ahmed Abdelal
AboutHero.description: With 3+ years of experience in full-stack web development, I specialize in building scalable, performant applications using modern technologies. My passion lies in solving complex problems with clean, efficient code and creating seamless digital experiences from concept to deployment.

paragraphs.p1: My journey in software development began when I wrote my first line of code in university. What started as curiosity about how applications work quickly evolved into a passion for building scalable, efficient digital solutions. I was fascinated by the power of code to solve real-world problems.
paragraphs.p2: Over the past 3+ years, I've had the opportunity to work on diverse projects ranging from startup MVPs to enterprise-level applications. Each project has deepened my understanding of full-stack development and refined my problem-solving skills across different tech stacks.
paragraphs.p3: My approach combines technical excellence with user-centric design. I believe that great applications are not just functional—they're intuitive, performant, and provide seamless experiences across all devices and platforms.
paragraphs.p4: I'm passionate about continuous learning and staying updated with the latest technologies. When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new frameworks, contributing to open-source projects, or sharing knowledge with the developer community.
